text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Man, I'm in the mood to go on a massive 
shopping spree without caring about the 
consequences..."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
It'd be so fun to fill up a shopping 
basket... Hanpen, pea sprouts, bean 
sprouts, and...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"It doesn't seem like she's indulging in 
luxury. Even so, she appears considerably 
exhausted."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"It's likely due to running in consecutive 
races. We should review the schedule for 
the future."
